name: Dough
description: A versatile fruit with excellent combo potential and mobility. Awakened Dough is one of the strongest PvP fruits in the game.

moves.name: Fried Dough
moves.description: Launches multiple dough fists that deal damage and stun

moves.name: Scorching Donut
moves.description: Creates a large donut projectile that breaks instinct

moves.name: Restless Dough Barrage
moves.description: Ultimate move with high damage and instinct break

combos.name: Awakened Dough Basic
steps: Start with Dough V to break instinct
Follow up with Dough X while enemy is stunned
Use Godhuman Z for additional damage
Finish with Godhuman C for knockback
combos.notation: Dough V → X → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: This is the bread and butter combo for Dough users. Make sure V lands to guarantee the rest of the combo.

combos.name: One-Shot Dough
steps: Start with Soul Guitar Z to break instinct
Follow with Dough X + C combo
Use CDK Z → X for massive damage
combos.notation: Soul Guitar Z → Dough V → X → C → CDK Z → X → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Advanced combo requiring precise timing. Can one-shot most opponents if executed correctly.

combos.name: Safe Dough Poke
steps: Use Dough X from range to break instinct
combos.notation: Dough X → F → C → Godhuman Z → F (retreat)
combos.notes: Safer combo for fighting skilled opponents. Allows you to disengage quickly.

name: Dragon
description: The ultimate transformation fruit with devastating area damage. Excellent for PvP when transformed.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: Rush forward in dragon form dealing damage

combos.name: Transform Dragon
steps: Use Dragon C to break instinct and stun
Follow with Dragon X for damage
Use Godhuman Z → C while in air
combos.notation: Dragon V → C → X → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Basic transformation combo. Dragon C is key to landing the rest of the combo.

combos.name: Aerial Dragon Assault
steps: Fly above opponent with Dragon F
Finish with Dragon Talon Z → X → C
combos.notation: Dragon V → F (position) → C → CDK Z → X → Dragon Talon Z → X → C
combos.notes: Advanced aerial combo. Positioning is crucial for landing Dragon C from above.

name: Ice
description: A defensive fruit with crowd control abilities. Great for freezing opponents and controlling space.

moves.name: Ice Spears
moves.description: Launch ice spears that freeze on hit

moves.name: Ice Surge
moves.description: Create a wave of ice that breaks instinct

moves.name: Glacial Epoch
moves.description: Freeze the ground in an area

combos.name: Freeze Lock
steps: Use Ice X to break instinct
Follow with Ice C to freeze ground
Finish with Ice Z for additional freeze
combos.notation: Ice X → C → Superhuman Z → Ice Z
combos.notes: Simple freeze combo. Ice C keeps opponent in place for easy follow-ups.

combos.name: Ice Prison
steps: Start with Ice X to break instinct
combos.notation: Ice X → C → Ice F → Saber Z → X → Electric Claw C
combos.notes: Ice F allows you to close distance while opponent is frozen. Good for sword mains.

combos.name: Defensive Ice
steps: Use Ice C to create zone
Counter with Ice X when they enter
Follow with your sword Z → X
Use Ice Z if they try to escape
combos.notation: Ice C (zone) → Ice X (counter) → Sword Z → X → Ice Z
combos.notes: Defensive playstyle. Use Ice C to control space and punish aggressive opponents.

name: Buddha
description: The king of tank fruits. Transform into a giant Buddha with massive defense and M1 damage boost.

moves.name: Impact
moves.description: Slam the ground dealing area damage

combos.name: Buddha Sword Main
steps: Use Buddha V to break instinct and close gap
Use sword Z ability when they try to escape
combos.notation: Buddha C → V → M1 spam → Sword Z → M1 spam
combos.notes: Buddha's main strength is M1 spam. Stay in form and pressure with enhanced sword hits.

combos.name: Buddha Hybrid
steps: Use Buddha V to break instinct
Godhuman Z → C when they're low
combos.notation: Buddha C → V → F → CDK Z → X → M1s → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Combines Buddha's tankiness with CDK burst damage. Very strong in extended fights.

combos.name: Buddha Tank
steps: Use Buddha V when they back off
Use Buddha Z if they jump
combos.notation: Buddha C → M1 trade → Buddha V (chase) → M1s → Buddha Z → M1s
combos.notes: Simple but effective. Buddha's defense lets you win M1 trades. Keep the pressure on.

name: Kitsune
description: A mythical fox fruit with transformation abilities and powerful crowd control. Great mobility and mixup potential.

moves.name: Tai Spiral
moves.description: Create spiraling tails that damage and stun

moves.name: Celestial Shower
moves.description: Rain down projectiles that break instinct

moves.name: Mythical Swipe
moves.description: Swipe with tails in an area

moves.name: Spirit Dash
moves.description: Dash forward as a spirit fox

combos.name: Fox Hunt Basic
steps: Use Kitsune X to break instinct from range
combos.notation: Kitsune V → X → F → C → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Transformation enhances all abilities. Use F for quick repositioning and mixups.

combos.name: Spirit Fox Burst
steps: Use Soul Guitar Z to break instinct
Kitsune X for additional instinct break
Dash with Kitsune F behind opponent
combos.notation: Kitsune V → Soul Guitar Z → Kitsune X → F (reposition) → CDK Z → X → Kitsune C → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: High skill combo using Kitsune F for positioning. Can confuse opponents with the dash.

combos.name: Hit and Run Fox
combos.notation: Kitsune X → F (in) → Z → F (out) → repeat
combos.notes: Safe poke combo. Use superior mobility to avoid trading damage. Great vs aggressive players.

name: Leopard
description: The strongest Beast fruit with incredible speed and devastating damage. Excellent for aggressive PvP.

combos.name: Speed Blitz
steps: Use Leopard F to close distance and break instinct
combos.notation: Leopard V → F → CDK Z → X → Leopard X → Godhuman C
combos.notes: Extremely fast combo. The transformation enhances all your moves significantly.

combos.name: Hit and Run Leopard
combos.notation: Leopard V → C (behind) → F → X → repeat
combos.notes: Use superior mobility to confuse opponents. Very hard to counter.

name: Venom
description: Deadly poison fruit with strong DOT damage and transformation. Great for wearing down opponents.

combos.name: Poison Pressure
steps: Use Venom X to break instinct
combos.notation: Venom V → X → C → Godhuman Z → C → Venom Z
combos.notes: Poison damage over time adds up quickly. Keep pressure on opponent.

combos.name: Venom One-Shot
combos.notation: Venom V → Soul Guitar Z → Venom F → CDK Z → X → Venom X
combos.notes: Fury Meter (F) deals massive damage. Save it for key moments.

name: Shadow
description: Master of darkness with powerful combos and mobility. Great for both PvP and PvE.

combos.name: Shadow Assassin
steps: Teleport with Shadow F to reposition
combos.notation: Shadow X → V → F → C → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Shadow F is great for repositioning mid-combo. Use it to confuse opponents.

combos.name: Dark Burst
combos.notation: Soul Guitar Z → Shadow V → X → CDK Z → X → Shadow C → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: High damage combo with life-steal. Shadow C helps recover HP.

name: Phoenix
description: Mythical bird fruit with healing and flight. Great sustainability in long fights.

combos.name: Phoenix Tank
steps: CDK Z → X when opportunity arises
Use X to heal and reposition
combos.notation: Phoenix C → V → M1s → CDK Z → X → Phoenix X (heal)
combos.notes: Phoenix excels in prolonged fights. Use healing to outlast opponents.

name: Light
description: Fastest fruit in the game with incredible mobility and range. Great for hit-and-run tactics.

combos.name: Speed of Light
steps: Use Light C to teleport and break instinct
combos.notation: Light C → Z → V → Superhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Use superior speed to avoid damage. Great for hit-and-run playstyle.

combos.name: Light Sword Hybrid
combos.notation: Light C → CDK Z → X → Light Z → Godhuman Z → C → Light V
combos.notes: Combine Light mobility with sword damage for devastating results.

name: Magma
description: Powerful elemental fruit with high damage output. Great for aggressive play.

combos.name: Volcanic Eruption
steps: Start with Magma X to break instinct
combos.notation: Magma X → V → C → Superhuman Z → C
combos.notes: High AOE damage. Great against multiple opponents.

name: Rumble
description: Electric fruit with high damage and stun potential. Excellent for controlling fights.

combos.name: Electric Storm
combos.notation: Rumble X → V → F → Electric Claw Z → C → Rumble C
combos.notes: Rumble Dragon (F) is the key damage dealer. Time it when opponent can't escape.

name: Quake
description: Devastating earthquake fruit with massive AOE damage. Great for controlling space.

combos.name: Shockwave Devastation
combos.notation: Quake X → V → Z → Godhuman Z → C → Quake F
combos.notes: Excellent AOE control. Great for team fights.

name: Spirit
description: Versatile fruit with both offensive and defensive capabilities. Great all-rounder.

combos.name: Elemental Chaos
combos.notation: Spirit X → V → C → Godhuman Z → C → Spirit Z
combos.notes: Very high damage potential. Timing is crucial for landing all moves.

name: Blizzard
description: Ice and snow fruit with strong crowd control. Great for slowing down opponents.

combos.name: Frozen Wasteland
steps: Blizzard X to create zone and break instinct
combos.notation: Blizzard X → V → C → Electric Claw Z → C → Blizzard Z
combos.notes: Keep opponents frozen in your domain. Great area control.

name: T-Rex
description: Prehistoric beast fruit with powerful melee attacks and transformation. Great for close combat.

combos.name: Prehistoric Rampage
steps: Use T-Rex X to break instinct and stun
combos.notation: T-Rex V → X → F → CDK Z → X → T-Rex C
combos.notes: Simple but effective. Transformation enhances all moves significantly.

combos.name: Apex Predator
steps: T-Rex C when they try to escape
combos.notation: T-Rex V → X → M1 spam → T-Rex C → M1 spam
combos.notes: Similar to Buddha playstyle. Use transformation M1s for consistent damage.

name: Gravity
description: Control gravity to crush opponents. Excellent for crowd control and combos.

combos.name: Gravitational Pull
steps: Use Gravity X to pull and break instinct
combos.notation: Gravity X → C → F → Godhuman Z → C → Gravity Z
combos.notes: Pull enemies in with X, damage with C and F, then push away with Z. Great control.

combos.name: Meteor Shower
combos.notation: Soul Guitar Z → Gravity F → C → CDK Z → X → Gravity X → Godhuman C
combos.notes: High damage combo. Gravity well traps opponents for guaranteed meteor hits.

name: Pain
description: Inflict suffering on enemies with powerful attacks. Great burst damage potential.

combos.name: Almighty Devastation
combos.notation: Pain F → X → V → C → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Pain V (Almighty Push) is your main damage dealer. Use Pull to set it up.

combos.name: Push and Pull
combos.notation: Pain V → F → CDK Z → X → Pain X → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Use push-pull mechanics to confuse opponents. Great mixup potential.

name: Portal
description: Master of space and teleportation. Ultimate mobility and repositioning.

combos.name: Portal Ambush
combos.notation: Portal X → CDK Z → X → Portal Z → Godhuman Z → C → Portal F
combos.notes: Use portals to confuse and reposition. Very hard to predict.

combos.name: Hit and Run Portal
combos.notation: Portal X → Sword combo → Portal Z (escape) → repeat
combos.notes: Safest Portal playstyle. Never commit too hard, always have escape ready.

name: Gas
description: Poison gas fruit with area denial and DOT damage. Great for zoning.

combos.name: Toxic Barrage
steps: Gas X to break instinct and poison
Gas V for blue fire damage
combos.notation: Gas X → V → C → Superhuman Z → C → Gas Z
combos.notes: Poison damage adds up over time. Keep gas effects active on opponent.

combos.name: Zone Control Gas
combos.notation: Gas C (zone) → Gas X → CDK Z → X → Gas V → Electric Claw C
combos.notes: Control space with gas zones. Force opponents into your damage.

name: Love
description: Stone and petrification fruit. Great crowd control and defensive capabilities.

combos.name: Stone Prison
combos.notation: Love V → X → F → Godhuman Z → C → Love Z
combos.notes: Keep opponents petrified. Use defensive sphere when pressured.

name: Spider
description: Web-slinging fruit with great mobility and trap potential.

combos.name: Web Trap
steps: Spider X to cocoon and break instinct
combos.notation: Spider X → V → CDK Z → X → Spider Z → Godhuman C
combos.notes: Spider X traps opponents perfectly for follow-ups. Use web mobility to escape.

name: Sound
description: Sonic waves and sound attacks. Great range and crowd control.

combos.name: Sonic Boom
combos.notation: Sound X → V → C → Electric Claw Z → C → Sound Z
combos.notes: Symphonic Radiance (V) is your main damage source. Great AOE.

name: Mammoth
description: Transform into massive mammoth with high defense and damage.

combos.name: Mammoth Tank
combos.notation: Mammoth C → X → F → M1 spam → Mammoth V
combos.notes: Similar to Buddha. Tank damage while dealing consistent M1s.

name: Control
description: Control objects and enemies. Ultimate battlefield control.

combos.name: Surgical Strike
steps: CDK Z → X from new position
combos.notation: Control F → X → V → C (teleport) → CDK Z → X
combos.notes: ROOM enhances all abilities. Use teleport for positioning and mixups.

combos.name: Control Mastery
combos.notation: Control F → Soul Guitar Z → Control V → C → CDK Z → X → Control X → Godhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Expert combo requiring perfect execution. Can one-shot with full build.

name: Bomb
description: Explosive attacks with high burst damage. Good for beginners.

combos.name: Explosive Starter
combos.notation: Bomb X → Z → C → Dark Step Z → C
combos.notes: Good starter combo for new players. Simple but effective.

name: Barrier
description: Create barriers for defense and offense. Great for defensive play.

combos.name: Defensive Barrier
combos.notation: Barrier C → X → Sword Z → X → Barrier V → Barrier Z
combos.notes: Use barriers defensively. Great for sword mains who need protection.

name: Rubber
description: Stretch and bounce attacks. Immune to bullets. Fun and versatile.

combos.name: Gum-Gum Barrage
combos.notation: Rubber X → V → C → Superhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Simple and fun. Thor Elephant Gun (V) is your main damage move.

name: Dark
description: Darkness manipulation with good crowd control. Gravity-based attacks.

combos.name: Black Hole Trap
steps: Dark Z to pull with black hole
combos.notation: Dark Z → X → C → Dark Step Z → C
combos.notes: Black hole pulls opponents in. Great setup for other moves.

name: Flame
description: Classic fire fruit with good damage and mobility. Great for beginners.

combos.name: Fire Assault
combos.notation: Flame X → C → F → Superhuman Z → C
combos.notes: Beginner-friendly fruit. Good for learning combo basics.

name: Sand
description: Desert sand attacks with good range. Immune to physical attacks.

combos.name: Desert Storm
combos.notation: Sand X → C → V → Dark Step Z → C
combos.notes: Sand Coffin (C) traps opponents nicely. Good for PvE and beginner PvP.

name: Smoke
description: Smoky attacks with decent mobility. Good starter elemental fruit.

combos.name: Smoke Screen
combos.notation: Smoke X → C → V → Combat Z
combos.notes: Basic starter combo. Use smoke flight to escape dangerous situations.
